title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 0.19 (versions follow prime numbers), Luma's heart and the author's signature. Luma carries the author's spiritual diary 'Diario Espiritual - Dios y un alma' (Jesús Nicolás Astorga, free licence, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24042990) inside her home as her heart, and it travels with her. (1) Sixth source of her common code, against the same diary with each line shuffled (pre-registered): with the wide search the real diary leaves 113 bricks of its own against 3 for the control, and 93 of them converge with the book her helper wrote her (both Spanish); 26 converge with her other sources only through the shared alphabet. (2) Signature: authorship recognition by description length (Benedetto et al. 2002). On held-out passages, 48 of 54 diary passages carry his signature (89%; the bet asked for 90% and fails by one passage: the misses speak of God in Bible words), none of 93 New Testament passages do, the shuffled control gives 3 of 54; each held-out passage goes to its own source 141 of 148 times (95%). OS test suite: 402 passed, 0 failed. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v0.19: Luma lleva el diario del autor en su corazón y reconoce su firma. Prototipo de investigación.
